_comment: The self-hosted runners this repository EXPECTS to be serving jobs.
runner-watchdog.yml. Listing the live runners needs admin, which the
workflow token does not have; a finished job's runner_name does not. So
the expected set is declared here, and a runner that takes no job while
jobs it could take run on another runner is reported.
name   = the GitHub registration (NROS_RUNNER_NAME on its host).
labels = the nros-* labels it registers with. GitHub adds self-hosted,
Linux and X64 itself. Keep this in step with the host's loop
command line: a label listed here and not served makes the check
expect jobs the runner never sees, and the reverse hides a gap.
Remove a runner here in the same change that retires its host.
